note: Spoken English voice-over for each help video (Kokoro TTS, voice af_heart, same as the reMarketplace explainer). One line per step; 'at' is when the step starts in the silent recording. 'captions' turns the spoken spellings back into written form for the English captions. 'phonemes' fixes espeak pronunciations (Hostia as HOST-ee-uh). Written for the ear: brand as 'Global Hostia', no URLs spelled out. narrate.py speaks each line, holds frames where a line needs more time than its step, and writes the English captions from these lines.

add-a-dns-record.text: In your Global Hostia account, open Domains. Then choose the domain you want to update.
Scroll down to DNS records, and open Add a record.
Pick the record type. Here, it's a TXT record. Then enter the name, and paste in the value your provider gave you.
Now, click Add record. It shows up in the list straight away. And it's usually live within a few minutes.

change-nameservers.text: In your account, open Domains, and choose the domain you want to point somewhere else.
Replace the nameservers with the ones you were given. You can use two, or add more if your provider lists them.
Changes usually work within a few hours, and up to a day worldwide.

change-php-version.text: In Manage hosting, open PHP version.
Choose the domain, then pick the PHP version your site needs.
Then open your website, and check that everything still works.

connect-a-domain.text: Open Manage hosting. The overview lists any domains that aren't connected yet.
Click Connect next to the domain.
Follow the steps. Either switch the nameservers, or add the A-record and the W W W record shown.
The helper checks again every thirty seconds, and ticks off each step as soon as it's live.

create-a-database.text: In Manage hosting, open Databases, and click New database.
Enter a database name and a user name. Your account prefix is added for you.
Click Generate for a strong password, and save it somewhere safe. Then click Create database.
Connect your app using local host, with the new name, user, and password.

give-team-access.text: Open Team access from your account menu.
Choose an access level, such as Developer, or Billing only.
Send the invite. You can change or remove their access at any time.

install-wordpress.text: In Manage hosting, open WordPress, and click Install WordPress.
Choose the domain, and enter your site title and admin email. Then start the install. It only takes a moment.
When it's ready, click Log in to WordPress admin. No password needed.
To try out changes safely, open the site menu, and choose Create staging copy.

issue-ssl-certificate.text: Find the domain marked Not secure. Keep Include W W W ticked.
Click Issue free SSL, and wait a few seconds.
The domain now shows Secure, with its expiry date. And it renews automatically.

open-a-support-ticket.text: Open Support, and click New ticket.
Choose the department, and the service your question is about.
Write a short subject, and describe what you're seeing. Then submit the ticket.
You can open the ticket any time to read our replies, and answer in the reply box.

pay-an-invoice.text: In your account, open Billing from the menu.
Choose Unpaid, to see only the invoices that are due.
Click Pay next to the invoice you want to pay.
The invoice opens in our secure client area. Choose a payment method, and confirm.

renew-services.text: Here you can see what's overdue, and what renews in the next thirty and ninety days.
Tick the services and domains you want to renew.
Click Renew in the bar at the bottom. Then pay for everything you ticked, on one invoice.

restore-a-backup.text: Find a backup from before the problem started.
Click Restore, and confirm. Any files changed since then are replaced.
You'll get an email when the restore is done. Want a copy of today first? Use Create backup.

sell-a-domain.text: Open Sell domains, and click List a domain.
Choose the domain from your account.
Set your price, the lowest offer you'll accept, and a short description.
Accept the terms, and continue. Your listing goes live after a quick review, and the listing fee.

set-up-email.text: In Manage hosting, open Mailboxes, and click New mailbox.
Enter the mailbox name, and a strong password. Then click Create.
Next to the new mailbox, click Set up on device.
Pick your app. iPhone gets a one-tap profile, and Android and Outlook get the exact server settings.

switch-language.text: Open the account menu, at the top right.
Choose Arabic. Your account switches to Arabic, and reads right to left.
Your choice is remembered on this device.
To switch back, open the same menu, and choose English.

upload-files.text: In Manage hosting, open File manager.
Pick the website. Its public H T M L folder opens.
Click Upload, and choose your file. Files up to four megabytes work here. For bigger ones, use F T P.
The file appears in the list as soon as the upload finishes.
